Recognize AI helpers in daily life

realLifeExample.aiConnection: Alexa is an AI helper that listens and answers

visualAid.description: Simple diagram showing AI as smart helper

auraGuidance.intro: NOW let's understand what AI really is!
auraGuidance.key: AI is like a SMART HELPER in machines
auraGuidance.check: Do you see AI helpers at your home?

realLifeExample.observation: More you watch, smarter it gets!

games.title: AI or Not AI?
games.instruction: Drag items to correct bucket: AI Helper or Regular Tool

items.label: Face Recognition Camera
items.feedback: YES! Camera uses AI to recognize faces

items.label: Regular Fan
items.feedback: Correct! Fan just spins, no AI needed

items.label: Voice Assistant
items.feedback: GREAT! Voice assistants use AI to understand you

auraGuidance.start: LET'S PLAY! Drag items to correct bucket
auraGuidance.incorrect: TRY AGAIN! Think about what AI does
auraGuidance.hint: AI learns and thinks, regular tools just follow switches

games.title: Find AI in the House
games.instruction: Tap on objects that use AI

targets.explanation: Smart TV uses AI to recommend shows!

auraGuidance.start: LOOK AROUND! Tap objects with AI
auraGuidance.complete: EXCELLENT! You found all AI helpers!

games.title: Match AI with What It Does
games.instruction: Match each AI helper with its job

auraGuidance.start: MATCH them! Connect AI with what it does

activities.title: AI Detective at Home
steps: Walk around your house with an adult
Look for devices that might use AI
Draw or write down 5 things you find
Ask adult if each one uses AI
activities.familyConnection: Parents can explain how each device works and whether it uses AI

auraGuidance.after: GREAT WORK! Share what you found!

realWorldExamples.title: Mom's Smart Speaker
realWorldExamples.scenario: Every morning, mom asks Alexa for weather
realWorldExamples.aiConnection: Alexa uses AI to understand speech and find weather info
realWorldExamples.observation: Notice: Alexa gets better at understanding your voice over time
realWorldExamples.discussion: Why does Alexa sometimes misunderstand? (AI is learning!)

realWorldExamples.title: YouTube Recommendations
realWorldExamples.scenario: YouTube shows videos similar to what you watched
realWorldExamples.aiConnection: AI watches your watching patterns and suggests similar content
realWorldExamples.observation: More you watch cartoons, more cartoon suggestions you get
realWorldExamples.discussion: Is this helpful or does it limit what you discover?

practiceExercises.title: Daily AI Spotter
practiceExercises.instruction: Sort these daily activities by whether AI helps

items.explanation: Netflix uses AI to recommend shows

feedback.incorrect: Think again: Does this learn or adapt?

keyTakeaways: AI is like a smart helper in machines
AI learns from examples and gets smarter
We use AI every day without noticing
Not all machines use AI - some just follow switches
lessonSummary.studentReflection: What was the coolest AI helper you learned about today?
